table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	documentcode = 'SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), Saleledger.SaleInvCode))),
	Type = 'Sale',
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	refsaleinvcode=dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	impactinventory = DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory,
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,    
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,    
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,
	CustRefNo   = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
	remarks     = dbo.saleledger.Remarks,
	looseqty = dbo.saledetail.looseqty, 
	packing=case when dbo.item.packcode IS Null then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end,
	itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,
	packqty  = saledetail.packqty,  
	price = dbo.saledetail.saleprice,    
	itemdiscperc = dbo.saledetail.discperc,    
	packunits = dbo.saledetail.packunits,    
	batch = dbo.saledetail.batch,    
	expiry = dbo.saledetail.expiry,    
	salestax  = saledetail.salestax,
	itemname = item.name,
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
	custalias = dbo.accounts.aliasname,
	Person = dbo.accounts.name,
	patient=(select name from patient where  patientcode=:ai_patientcode),
	regno = (select regno from patient where  patientcode=:ai_patientcode)
FROM
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.accounts
WHERE  
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = :ai_custcode and
	dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode = :ai_patientcode and
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
	dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	documentcode = 'SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), Saleledger.SaleInvCode))),
	Type = 'Sale',
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	refsaleinvcode=dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	impactinventory = DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory,
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,    
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,    
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,
	CustRefNo   = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
	remarks     = dbo.saleledger.Remarks,
	looseqty = sd.looseqty, 
	packing=case when dbo.item.packcode IS Null then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end,
	itemflatdisc=sd.itemflatdisc,
	packqty  = 0,  
	price = sd.saleprice,    
	itemdiscperc = sd.discperc,    
	packunits = sd.packunits,    
	batch = sd.batch,    
	expiry = sd.expiry,    
	salestax  = 0,
	itemname = item.name,
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
	custalias = dbo.accounts.aliasname,
	Person = dbo.accounts.name,
	patient=(select name from patient where  patientcode=:ai_patientcode),
	regno = (select regno from patient where  patientcode=:ai_patientcode)
FROM
	dbo.saleledger, 
	saleinvdetail sd,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.accounts
WHERE  
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = :ai_custcode and
	DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND 
	dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode = :ai_patientcode and
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
	sd.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	documentcode = 'SR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), SRledger.SRInvCode))),
	Type = 'Sale Return',
	saleinvcode = dbo.srledger.srinvcode,    
	refsaleinvcode=dbo.srledger.saleinvcode,
	impactinventory = 'Y',
	date = dbo.srledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.srledger.discperc,    
	flatdisc = dbo.srledger.flatdisc,    
	misccharges = dbo.srledger.misccharges, 
	invsalestax = dbo.srledger.salestax,
	CustRefNo   = dbo.srledger.CustRefNo,
	remarks     = dbo.srledger.Remarks,
	looseqty = dbo.srdetail.looseqty, 
	packing=case when dbo.item.packcode IS Null then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end,
	itemflatdisc=0.00,
	packqty  = 0,  
	price = dbo.srdetail.srprice,    
	itemdiscperc = dbo.srdetail.discperc,    
	packunits = dbo.srdetail.packunits,    
	batch = dbo.srdetail.batch,    
	expiry = dbo.srdetail.expiry,    
	salestax  = srdetail.salestax,
	itemname = item.name,
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, srledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, srledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, srledger.date)))), 
	custalias = dbo.accounts.aliasname,
	Person = dbo.accounts.name,
	patient=(select name from patient where  patientcode=:ai_patientcode),
	regno = (select regno from patient where  patientcode=:ai_patientcode)
FROM
	dbo.srledger, 
	dbo.srdetail,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.accounts
WHERE  
	dbo.srledger.custcode = :ai_custcode and
	dbo.srledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.srledger.srcatcode IN (6, 7, 8) and
	dbo.srledger.patientcode = :ai_patientcode and
	dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode and  
	dbo.srdetail.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode
table.sort: date D, type A, saleinvcode D

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round(((  looseqty   *  price  )-(itemflatdisc* looseqty))  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ), 2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round (Sum(((  looseqty   *  price  )-( itemflatdisc * looseqty ))  *  ( 1 - (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 2) *  ( 1 - invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)
